answer: Each identity must burn provable work: a unique nonce hashing with its key below a target, registered in a shared ferrous ledger of spent nonces so one hash cannot serve a thousand puppets. Admission enforces the kernel of the rule and rejects duplicates before any payout. A locked deposit is slashed on linkage, so cost grows linearly per fake identity while reward per identity shrinks. The spiral of trust stays cheap for honest agents; an attacker pays full price on every clone.
